text:
dana.sales: HorizonBank ran a 30m POC and hit sharp p99 spikes during small bursts. They asked for a one-paragraph explanation + an actionable re-test plan and a note on how this affects pricing/commit. Can we get something short they can paste into procurement?
otto.sre: Paste their test details? qps, model, seq len, clients, batching?
dana.sales: From them: 
  - model: open-redwood-7b-v1 (fp16)
  - baseline: 50 qps, bursts to 200 qps for 60s every 5m
  - clients: 20 threads from a single AZ
  - input tokens: mean 80, max 1200 (some long loan docs)
  - batching: client-side only
  - warmup: 2m
otto.sre: Short answer: uneven batch sizes + very long outliers = GPU stream blocking and KV cache churn -> tail spikes. Short warmup + single-AZ burst also exposes scheduling jitter.
kavi.ml: Model note: int8 variant helps throughput (~2-2.5x) with small eval delta; but batching+cache usually gives biggest tail improvement.
sara.se: Proposed re-test plan (30-60m measurement): 
  - warmup 10m with same burst pattern
  - enable server-side continuous batching (batch_timeout=8ms, max_batch=96)
  - add session_id so repeated flows use KV cache; route >512-token requests to an async job
  - collect p50/p90/p95/p99/p999, batch size histogram, gpu_util, memory headroom
  - include tracer id header for us to fetch traces
ben.sales-eng: Pricing note for their buyer: Hosted is lowest upfront; switching to int8 reduces per-token compute cost significantly; Dedicated (3-GPU pool) increases fixed monthly cost but gives predictable tails and easier data residency. I can produce a 90-day committed vs hosted comparison if they share target SLO and expected qps curve.
dana.sales: Can we offer a managed rerun where an SE applies batching/cache and delivers grafana snapshots + CSVs?
sara.se: Yes — managed POC available, typical turnaround 24-48h. We'll run the re-test and hand over raw metrics.
loadtest-bot: run_summary id=hb-20260501-01, failures=0, avg=120ms, p95=410ms, p99=1050ms
dana.sales: Great. I'll send them a one-paragraph explainer + the re-test plan and offer the managed POC and pricing note. Thanks all :thumbsup:
